name: Melty Caprese Steak with Butter Lettuce, Bell Pepper & Basil Salad

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing. Pour half into a large baking dish, then set the bowl aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut steak into portions, pat dry with paper towels, and add to the baking dish; turn to coat and set aside to marinate.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
3 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the peppers are done, return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, thinly slice tomatoes and mozzarella crosswise into rounds.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the steak is done, remove skillet from heat; top with tomatoes and mozzarella. Cover with a lid and let sit until cheese starts to melt, 2-3 minutes.
While the cheese melts, pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, along with the cooked peppers, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and steaks between plates. Top steaks with reserved basil and enjoy!
